output.heading: Introduction

spans.text: Re-executing a data pipeline months later frequently yields different outputs.
Prior work on Python pipelines reports that recording library versions restored most pipelines whose outputs changed after re-execution.
Whether this transfers to R, where package management differs, has not been measured.
We ask whether recording library versions restores outputs for R pipelines as it does for Python.
We hypothesise that version records help, but less reliably than for Python.
